questions.question: A flight covering a distance of 1200 km could reduce the travel time by 30 minutes, due to an additive tailwind that increases the average speed by 120 km/hr. What was the duration of the flight in hours?
questions.solution:
Total distance = 1200 km

As we know,

30 min = 1/2 hr

Let the speed of the flight be x km/hr

According to the question

⇒ 1200/x – 12000/(x + 120) = 1/2

⇒ 1200 [(x + 120 – x)/x (x + 120)] = 1/2

⇒ 1200 [120/(x² + 120x)] = 1/2

⇒ 1200 × 120 × 2 = x² + 120x

⇒ 288000 = x² + 120x

⇒ x² + 120x – 288000 = 0

⇒ x² + 600x – 480x – 288000 = 0

⇒ x (x + 600) – 480 (x + 600) = 0

⇒ (x + 600) (x – 480) = 0

Taking

⇒ (x – 480) = 0

⇒ x = 480 km/hr

Total distance = 1200 km

Speed = 480 km/hr

As we know,

Time = Distance/Speed

Time = 1200/480 = 2.5 hr or 2 hr 30 min

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** Let increased speed be S₁ and reduced time be T₁

Then, distance = T₁ × S(S + S₁)/S₁

⇒ 1200 = (1)/(2)× (S(S + 120))/(120)

⇒ S(S + 120) = 288000

⇒ S(S + 120) = 480 × 600

⇒ S = 480 km/h

⇒ Duration of the flight = 1200/480 = 2.5 h or 2 hr 30 min

**∴ The correct answer is 2 hr 30 min.**

questions.question: A clock shows 2 am now. Find the total rotation of the minute hand, in degrees, of the clock when it will show 9 pm on the same night?
questions.solution:
No. of hours between 2 am and 2 pm in a day = 12 hours

No. of hours between 2 pm and 9 pm in a day = 7 hours.

Therefore, total no. of hours between 2 am and 9 pm of the same day = 12 + 7 = 19 hours.

Angle rotated by a minute hand in 1 hour = 360°

Therefore, total rotation in 19 hours = 19 × 360° = 6840°

Hence, the correct answer is 6840°.

Distance = Time × speed

questions.question: The ratio of the ages of the father and the son ten years ago was 11:3. Ten years hence the ratio would be 21: 13. What are the present ages of the father and the son?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio 10 years ago = 11 : 3 (Difference = 8 parts)

Ratio 10 years hence = 21 : 13 (Difference = 8 parts)

As the ratio difference is same, increase in parts = 21 − 11 = 10 units.

Actual time gap = 10 + 10 = 20 years ⇒ 10 units = 20 years ⇒ 1 unit = 2 years.

Present ages = (11 × 2 + 10) and (3 × 2 + 10) = 32 and 16 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 32, 16 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio (F : S) 10 years ago = 11 : 3

Ratio (F : S) 10 years hence = 21 : 13

**Formula Used:**

If ratio is a : b, ages can be taken as ax and bx. Present age = Age at time T + T.

 
• 10 Yrs Ago 11 : 3 Present (P) 10 Yrs Hence 21 : 13 
 Gap = 20 Years 

**Calculations:**

Let the ages of father and son 10 years ago be 11x and 3x.

⇒ Present ages = (11x + 10) and (3x + 10)

⇒ Ages after 10 years from now = (11x + 10 + 10) and (3x + 10 + 10)

⇒ According to question: (11x + 20) ÷ (3x + 20) = 21 ÷ 13

⇒ 13 × (11x + 20) = 21 × (3x + 20)

⇒ 143x + 260 = 63x + 420

⇒ 143x − 63x = 420 − 260

⇒ 80x = 160

⇒ x = 2

⇒ Present age of Father = 11(2) + 10 = 22 + 10 = 32 years.

⇒ Present age of Son = 3(2) + 10 = 6 + 10 = 16 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 32, 16 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Constant Age Difference

The difference between the ages of two people remains constant throughout their lives, regardless of the number of years passed.

Ratio Normalization

To solve age problems quickly, ensure the difference between ratio terms (e.g., |a−b|) is the same for both time periods by multiplying with suitable factors.

Time Calculation

Total time interval between T years ago and T years hence is always T + T = 2T years.

questions.question: The plant part moves toward light, it is called _________.
questions.solution:
Option **1** is correct:

__
 
• **Phototropism **is the ability of a plant or other **photosynthesizing organism**, to grow directionally in response to a light source.
 
• Plant and other autotrophs need to manufacture their own food; they usually do this through** photosynthesis**.
 
• Through photosynthesis, organisms convert **water**, **carbon dioxide (CO₂) **and light into **sugar**, which is used for energy and growth.
 
• Plants can not move around to acquire what they need, so in order to maximize the amount of light that they receive through the leaves, they use **phototropism**.
 
• **Positive phototropism**__ is the response of a plant toward a light source, while **negative phototropism** causes growth in the opposite direction.
 
• If the plant parts i.e.** stem** moves towards the light, show **positive tropism**. And if the plant part that is** root** moves away from light, then it shows **negative tropism**.
